description: This file contains a class AttributeValidationTool with methods for validating and normalizing various attribute types, as well as functions for validating MISP attributes, events, and objects, including error handling and logging.

classes.name: ValidationError
classes.description: Custom exception class inheriting from PyMISPError, used for validation errors.

classes.name: AttributeValidationTool
classes.description: Class providing static and class methods for validating and normalizing different attribute types, including IP addresses, hashes, URLs, and more.

methods.name: validate_attribute
methods.description: Validates a single MISP attribute, normalizing its value and raising errors if invalid.

methods.name: validate_attributes
methods.description: Validates a list of MISP attributes, yielding only valid ones and recording errors.

methods.name: validate_event
methods.description: Validates an entire event, including its attributes and objects, skipping invalid entries.

methods.name: validate_object
methods.description: Validates a MISP object and its attributes, skipping invalid attributes.

methods.name: _load_misp_attribute
methods.description: Loads a dictionary into a MISPAttribute object.

methods.name: _load_misp_event
methods.description: Loads a dictionary into a MISPEvent object.

methods.name: _load_misp_object
methods.description: Loads a dictionary into a MISPObject object.
